text_block_list.text:
Фудзи Кисэки wins the autumn Tenno Sho in
a
stunning victory and gives the
audience a show to
remember, just like
she promised.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She's even more excited than usual after
the race.
It seems she's finally grasped
something
important as an entertainer!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Next up is the Arima Kinen. Her show is
finally
nearing its climax...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
